task: Split a song into vocals, drums, bass and the remaining instruments
packaging_note: The code image contains no model. A separate download container retrieves HTDemucs directly from its author to a local volume; it cannot see your song.

access.why: Downloads the 84 MB pretrained model from the author on first use. The container that reads the song has no network.

inputs.what: an audio file with music or singing

known_issues: CPU processing can be slow for long songs. The maintainer says the training data and model rights are unclear; consult the upstream licence notes for your use. No trained weights are redistributed here.
licence: MIT (code); the upstream maintainer does not specify clear redistribution rights for HTDemucs.

x-display.title: Separate a song into four tracks
x-display.summary: Split a song into separate vocals, drums, bass and other instruments as WAV files.
x-display.description: Bring the tracks into your music editor to work on one part at a time, practise alongside the backing, or study how a song is arranged. Each track covers the same song, so you can line them up again.
